name: JD Metal Fabrication and Welding
old_description: Hi – my name is Jacob Dice. I enjoy creating and fabricating. Check out the gallery of projects I have worked on below.
about:
JD Metal Fabrication and Welding operates from Liberty, Missouri, serving the greater Kansas City area. The shop was founded by Jacob Dice, who describes himself as someone who enjoys creating and fabricating. Dice runs the business as a hands-on fabricator, handling projects directly from the shop.

The company provides custom metal fabrication, welding, and CNC plasma cutting for a range of one-off and small-batch work. Core processes include AC/DC TIG welding, machining, CAD design, and mobile welding services. Project examples span entry gates, industrial repair, steel frame and railing fabrication, golf-course and sporting-facility signage, roll cages, fire pits, steel-and-walnut furniture, epoxy table tops, and custom CNC-cut steel parts.

Customers come from industrial maintenance, golf-course and sporting-facility operators, signage contractors, furniture makers, and automotive or racing teams needing roll cages. The shop also serves residential and commercial clients for gates, railings, fire pits, and decorative metalwork in the Liberty and Kansas City region.

The company emphasizes a custom-fit approach built around each client’s space, use, and material requirements, with direct communication from the fabricator doing the work and a focus on local service.
